newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia March forex reserves reach $19.872 bln.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia March forex reserves reach $19.872 bln.

text.p: Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves increased to $19.872 billion in March from $19.862 billion in February, a government official said on Thursday.
"Our reserves have increased to $19.872 billion in March," the official told Reuters.
Indonesia's foreign exchange reserves totalled $19.830 billion in January and $19.125 billion in December.
The country had foreign exchange reserves of $15.975 in March 1996.
